# NUI3

> Editorial, privacy-first React UI kit for Zcash / Noir apps. Warm paper + plum ink, one gold accent, serif display titles, Inter UI, IBM Plex Mono data. Radius 0, no shadows, tokens only.

Rules: spec/01-design-principles.md · Conventions: CONVENTIONS.md · Agent guide: AGENTS.md

## Setup
- CSS once at the root: src/nui3/css/nui3.css (full) or components.css (embeddable, no reset)
- Theme: <html data-nui-theme="paper|night|auto">, density data-nui-density="compact", ThemeProvider for subtrees, defineTheme + checkContrast for custom themes
- i18n: LocaleProvider locale="en|zh", useNuiLocale() → { m, number, t }

## Components (101)
- theme: ThemeProvider
- foundation: Display, Heading, Eyebrow, Lead, Shell, Section, Stack, Cluster, Grid, Icons (src/nui3/icons, *Icon), Spinner
- actions: Button, IconButton, ChipGroup, Tabs, TabPanel, Segmented, Menu
- forms: Field, Input, Textarea, Select (custom listbox), NativeSelect, InputGroup, SearchInput, Switch, Checkbox, Slider, FileDrop, Calendar, DatePicker, DateRangePicker
- navigation: ZcashMark, Brand, Header, Breadcrumb, Footer, SubNav
- surfaces: Card, ProjectCard, Panel, Stats, Stat, Badge, Alert, DataTable, KeyValue, Stepper, Progress, Skeleton, EmptyState
- overlays: Dialog, Drawer, ToastProvider / useToast
- zcash: Address, Hash, CopyButton / useCopy, Amount, PriceChange, PrivacyBadge, PoolBadge, ChainBadge, TokenIcon / TokenPair, TxStatus, SyncProgress, MemoInput, ReceiveQR, usePrivacyLevel
- defi: TokenAmountInput (price → fiat, built-in token dropdown, empty / insufficient / loading states), TokenPicker / TokenList, SwapSwitch, HealthFactor, DetailList
- trading: OrderBook, LeverageSlider, PnL, PositionTable, LiveValue, Countdown
- charts: LineChart, PriceChart, CandleChart, BarChart, DonutChart, DepthChart, BondingCurve, BondingCurveChart, Sparkline, Legend
- data: Meter, UptimeBar
- prediction: OutcomeButton, ProbabilityBar
- content: CodeBlock, SecretField, Timeline, Pagination, Tooltip, InfoTip, Disclosure, Identicon, NFTCard
- payments: BatchPayments, BatchPaymentTable
- i18n: LocaleProvider / useNuiLocale

## Utilities (src/nui3/utils)
- amounts: formatUnits, parseUnits, tryParseUnits, sanitizeAmountInput, formatAmount, formatFiat, formatFiatDecimal, mulDecimal, fiatValue, toDecimalString, percentOf, formatPercent, formatCompact, ZEC_DECIMALS, ZATOSHI_PER_ZEC
- addresses: parseAddress, isValidAddress, isShieldedAddress, addressKind, verifyBech32, truncateMiddle, ADDRESS_KIND_LABEL
- memo / ZIP-321: MEMO_MAX_BYTES, memoByteLength, isMemoValid, truncateMemo, encodeMemoBase64Url, buildPaymentUri
- CSV / batch: parseCsv, parsePaymentCsv, validatePayments
- dates (ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`, zone-safe): parseISODate, toISODate, addDays, addMonths, monthMatrix, startOfWeek, weekStartForLocale, clampISODate, orderRange, isInRange, formatISODate, formatISODateRange, parseDateInput, todayISO, defaultDatePresets
- misc: niceTicks, paginationRange, PRIVACY_LEVELS, DEFAULT_DISCLAIMER, cx
- theme: contrastRatio, checkContrast, defineTheme, toCssVars
